intent: Doorway nodes as DePIN CDN for static assets (fonts, icons, sophia UMD, HTML5 app ZIPs). Blobs are already content-addressed and served via /store/{hash}. Instead of build-time bundling, treat static assets as network content. Hybrid: bundle critical icon subset for bootstrap, load full set from doorway post-connection with SW caching. Shefa accounts for blob-serving bandwidth as measurable work. Prompted by font 404 bug in CI where fetch-fonts.sh was skipped.

Doorway dashboard 'Nodes' tab should always show 'this node' — the hardware the doorway is running on. This is device self-registration (imagodei concern), not orchestrator. The orchestrator is a separate elohim subagent that manages hardware-level concerns — on a cluster it balances compute across nodes (like a P2P k8s operator consuming shefa resource stats), but even on a single box it runs diagnostics, monitors disk/memory/thermal health, and could recommend hardware swaps. Same agent, different action space depending on topology. A doorway should be self-aware of its own node regardless. The health endpoint already has the data (conductor pools, workers). Clarify boundary: self-awareness = imagodei/doorway, hardware stewardship = orchestrator subagent (useful at any scale).

Bench-expansion Phase 2 + handler stream-reuse fix. Diagnosed silent 86-min hang in bench_sync_perf — every Phase 5–10 ALPN handler was one-stream-per-connection by design (accept_bi once, then park on connection.closed); bench tried to reuse a connection, stream 2 hung forever. Patched all 6 handlers (sync, epr×2, shard, view_fed, auth×2) to loop on accept_bi; existing parity tests still green. Rewrote 5 plane benches (sync, epr, epr_atom, shard, view_fed) with FRESH+REUSE scenarios on both stacks, added tokio::time::timeout(30s) safety on all bench reads. Iroh wins decisively on every chatty plane (45×–541× on sync REUSE), wins narrow on bulk transfer (shard at 4 MiB: 1.4×). Documented per-plane perf in 2026-05-08-iroh-libp2p-complementarity spec.
a2o_feature: none — engineering perf benches, not user-experience scenarios

summary: Coordinator-zome drift heal in happ_manager (elohim-storage). Root-caused why the 2f02879d attestation fix never reached running conductors: a Holochain DNA hash covers only integrity zomes + modifiers, so a coordinator-only change leaves the bundle's DNA hashes byte-identical to the installed app and has_dna_drift is structurally blind to it. Added per-zome coordinator wasm-hash comparison (bundle DnaFile vs get_dna_definition) healed via update_coordinators hot-swap (no re-key, no DHT churn), gated by ALLOW_COORDINATOR_UPDATE defaulting to ALLOW_DNA_REINSTALL. Learner impact: fixes the community ships actually reach the people running conductors. Acceptance measure: existing genesis propagation.custody-convergence gate flipping green (no new a2o scenario; unit tests pin the hash invariant).

Infrastructure-role late-connect in elohim-storage main.rs. Loki showed connect_role('infrastructure') failing 5/5 with CellDisabled (it connects FIRST, in the coldest post-restart window) and the boot-gated block silently disabling the PeerStatus heartbeat plus five signal subscribers (Infrastructure->peer_statuses, REA, ElohimContent, Mishpat, CommitmentByState drain) for the pod's lifetime. Rewired with the genesis-#1122 connect_role_forever in-task pattern. Learner impact: peer-online counts and projection-backed views (EPR resilience tooltip onlinePeerCount, attestation/mishpat projections) light up instead of staying dark after slow boots. Acceptance measure: resilience.peer-statuses lighting in genesis runs; remaining tooltip zeros are the workstream-D humans-junction/provide-row gaps.

Doorway now speaks the kitsune2 bootstrap protocol (PUT /bootstrap/{space}/{agent} + GET /bootstrap/{space}); previously every HC 0.6 conductor bootstrap request 404'd through the route registry, so conductors never discovered each other and DHT entries (custody commitments, doorway registrations) never gossiped between peers. Learner impact: published content's custody/protection claims can now actually converge on every peer instead of only the authoring node. A2O: substrate propagation gates (custody-convergence) are the acceptance surface; consider a doorway-bootstrap regression scenario in features/federation/.

elohim-storage now decodes conductor app signals from the real msgpack wire (holo_hash fields arrive as byte arrays, not base64 strings); PeerStatusRecorded signals were silently dropped at debug level, leaving peer_statuses empty and the EPR tooltip's online-peer count dark. Decode misses on known variants are now counted and logged loud. Learner impact: live peer counts on resilience surfaces light up. A2O: resilience-dimensions.feature peer-status rows are the acceptance surface.

ResilienceSnapshotView gained distributionState unmeasured|measured and details.onlinePeers {live,known}; bulk-seeded content (no shard manifest) now declares itself 'not yet distributed' instead of rendering a fake at-risk verdict, and peer counts read '2/3 peers live' with honest denominators. Learner impact: the demo content stops lying about protection. A2O: extend resilience-dimensions.feature with an unmeasured-state scenario (D1 boundary).

Resilience snapshot card now passes contrast in both themes and follows the device dark theme: the component bound tokens that existed in no palette (frozen white surfaces under inherited dark-theme text — invisible status label), the shell styles.css lacked the color-scheme contract (Canvas stayed white on the dark app), and the panel inherited title-scale fonts and spilled values outside its surface. Learner impact: the protection claim is readable for everyone, in their preferred theme. A2O: a theme-contrast scenario for the snapshot panel would guard the regression class (C2).
